issues.issue: [fixed] The P&L is the only object-level breakdown in the filing, and none of it is in detail[] (detail is [] and detail_totals is []). The notes leave it out 'to avoid double counting', but the rules keep detail separate from receipts/disbursements, so entering it wouldn't double count. Its total expense equals the waiver's operating expenses.

Checked the 1,065.11 gap: it isn't a misread. p1 reads 24,539.79 and its own math works (758,063.78 + 152,844.41 + 24,539.79 + 192,348.27 = 1,127,796.25; less 216,676.76 = 911,119.49). The crossed-out p2 reads 23,474.68 (total 1,126,731.14, ending 910,054.38), and it matches the balance sheet checking/savings total 910,054.38 (p3), the P&L interest (p4) and the trial balance (p5). The gap is 24,539.79 - 23,474.68 = 1,065.11 exactly. The unmarked page was used per the void-page rule; the decision_needed entry is in place.
The second digit is ambiguous (looks like 6 or a slashed 0). 208,176.76 is confirmed by total disbursements 216,676.76 less 8,500.00 and by the P&L total expense 208,176.76.
The source isn't stated; the books call it Misc Revenue. State aid follows the waiver form line and is defensible.
A toll bridge financed by tolls and keeping accrual books works like an enterprise; recording it all as governmental is a judgment call.
